runs.content: Mettler-Toledo (NYSE, $1,533.48) was bought as the day's momentum pick. It is up ~35% over 3 months and near its 52-week high after a Q2 beat and a raised FY26 EPS guide, and Barclays lifted its target to $1,700 on 10-07; it is healthcare / lab-instruments momentum outside the AI-capex names the B scan also surfaced. RTX was exited as a capacity trim (−7.50%, −$75; weakest position, no thesis break). No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $2.34 from T1 and HPQ is $5.28 from T2. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,298 (+1.75% on $74,000).

Universal Health Services (NYSE, $177.08) was bought as the day's value pick. It trades at ~7x earnings with positive FCF, 27% below its 52-week high; it's a Burry-aligned peer of his HCA long, and Q3 results land on 10-26. INCY was exited as a capacity trim (−8.50%, −$85); it was the weakest position and its momentum premise had failed. No stop/T1/T2 triggers; CVX is $9.93 from T1 and HPQ is $5.79 from T2. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,413 (+1.94% on $73,000).
